mini.solar_dodge.goal.en: Last 26 seconds without losing all hull
mini.solar_dodge.goal.zh-TW: 撐過 26 秒，血量別歸零

mini.solar_dodge.link.en: Solar storm protons can fry electronics. Safe mode, instruments off and facing the Sun are the real fixes; better shielding helps too.
mini.solar_dodge.link.zh-TW: 太陽風暴的高能粒子會打壞電子零件。進安全模式、關儀器、對日是真的處置，護盾越好也越耐打。
